segments.name: Primary Reporting Unit
segments.description: Sells personal care, wellness and quality-of-life products through a member network and e-commerce platforms across several international markets.
segments.evidence: Therefore, the Company aggregates its other operating segments (including its Hong Kong operating segment) into a single reporting segment (the "Primary Reporting Unit").

revenueModel.text: Independent members pay the company for wellness, beauty and lifestyle products bought for their own use or for resale to consumers.
revenueModel.evidence: Virtually all of our members are independent full-time or part-time contractors who purchase products directly from our subsidiaries via the internet for their own personal consumption or for resale to retail consumers.
